Employee HR Policy
Northstar Solutions - Internal Knowledge Document
Company
Northstar Solutions is a fictional technology company used for this AI project.
Working Hours
Standard working hours are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday through Friday.
Remote Work

Remote Work
Employees may work remotely up to two days per week with manager approval.
Probation
New employees have a probation period of six months.
Performance Reviews
Employee performance reviews take place every six months.
Employee Benefits

Employee Benefits
Eligible full-time employees receive health insurance and professional development support.

Information Security Policy
Northstar Solutions - Internal Knowledge Document
Password Requirements
Passwords must contain at least 12 characters, including uppercase letters, lowercase letters,
numbers and special characters.
Multi-Factor Authentication

Multi-Factor Authentication
Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for company email, cloud platforms and internal business
applications.
Data Access
Employees may access only the information required for their assigned job responsibilities.
Data Sharing

Data Sharing
Confidential company information must not be shared with unauthorized individuals or personal
email accounts.
Security Incidents
Suspected security incidents must be reported to the IT security team within one hour of discovery.
Device Security

Device Security
Company laptops must use full-disk encryption and automatic screen locking.

Leave and Attendance Policy
Northstar Solutions - Internal Knowledge Document
Annual Leave
Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.
Sick Leave
Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave per calendar year.
Public Holidays

Public Holidays
The company observes 12 public holidays each calendar year.
Leave Approval
Planned leave requests should be submitted at least five working days in advance.
Emergency Leave
Employees should notify their manager as soon as reasonably possible when emergency leave is
required.

required.
Attendance
Employees are expected to record their attendance through the company's attendance system.
Late Arrival
Employees arriving more than 15 minutes late should notify their manager.
